free_text: Despite the EAU guideline suggesting exclusion due to low PSA density (0.09 ng/mL²) and velocity (0.65 ng/mL/yr), the PI-RADS 4 finding with a lesion size of 18 mm in the peripheral zone remains a significant factor. The panel protocol was driven by an identical precedent in the labelled series, suggesting biopsy, and the retrieved documents did not provide a specific finding to overturn this consensus. Therefore, I recommend proceeding with a repeat biopsy to address the high-risk imaging finding.
